description: [Merchant] Cancel an ACTIVE transaction created by this merchant. Only the merchant who created the transaction can cancel it, and only before it has been processed.

partnerId.description: Partner ID from payware dashboard. Can use PAYWARE_PARTNER_ID env var as default.

privateKey.description: RSA private key for JWT token creation. Can use PAYWARE_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH env var as default.

transactionId.description: Transaction ID to cancel (must be an ACTIVE 'pw' transaction created by this merchant). Format: 'pw' + 8 characters. Product ('pr') and soundbite ('ps') ids are NOT cancellable - deactivate those through the products API.

name: payware_operations_cancel_transaction
